blurb: Sand Flats Recreation Area provides access to sustainable and enjoyable recreational opportunities including mountain biking on trails such as the Slickrock Bike Trail, 4x4 trails, and camping. The area is managed to protect natural features from adverse recreational impacts. It borders wilderness study areas and is near the Colorado River and Arches National Park.
